lesson.title: 用极限定律计算极限
lesson.description: 8 个知识点、11 道教材例题与全部 64 道节后习题；按方法关联例题和练习，提供逐步解析。

en.title: Calculating Limits Using the Limit Laws
en.description: 8 concepts, all 11 textbook examples, and all 64 section exercises, with method-based links and step-by-step solutions.

source.title: James Stewart · Calculus: Early Transcendentals, 7th Edition

concepts.title: 极限定律与图像读值
concepts.summary: 若 $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=L$、$\lim_{x\to a}g(x)=M$ 都存在，则和、差、常数倍、积分别趋于 $L+M,L-M,cL,LM$；商趋于 $L/M$ 要求 $M\ne0$。正整数次幂趋于 $L^n$。常数的极限等于常数，$\lim_{x\to a}x=a$。

method.title: 先检查每个极限
method.body: 从左右两侧读取曲线趋近的高度，区分实心点的函数值与曲线的极限。

method.title: 检查法则的条件
method.body: 只有各极限存在才直接组合；除法还需分母极限非零。若一个双侧极限不存在，改算左右两侧。

method.title: 代入极限值并计算
method.body: 写出所用法则和具体运算。左右结果相同时才给出双侧极限。

pitfalls: 分母趋于 $0$ 不能直接用商法则。
不能把不存在的极限当作数字相加或相乘。

en.title: Limit laws and reading graphs
en.summary: If $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=L$ and $\lim_{x\to a}g(x)=M$ exist, the limits of their sum, difference, constant multiple, and product are $L+M,L-M,cL,LM$. The quotient tends to $L/M$ only when $M\ne0$. A positive integer power tends to $L^n$. A constant tends to itself, and $\lim_{x\to a}x=a$.

method.title: Check the component limits
method.body: Read the approached height from both sides. Distinguish a filled point, which gives the function value, from the limit of the curve.

method.title: Check the hypotheses
method.body: Combine existing limits; division also requires a nonzero denominator limit. If a two-sided component limit fails, calculate the two one-sided limits instead.

method.title: Substitute the limiting values
method.body: Show the law and the arithmetic. A two-sided limit exists only when the two one-sided results agree.

pitfalls: Do not apply the Quotient Law when the denominator tends to $0$.
An absent limit cannot be treated as a number in a sum or product.

concepts.title: 直接代入与根式条件
concepts.summary: 多项式在每个实数处都可直接代入；有理函数在原分母非零处可直接代入。根式法则为 $\lim\sqrt[n]{f(x)}=\sqrt[n]{L}$，其中 $n$ 是正整数；本节对偶数 $n$ 的法则要求 $L>0$，边界 $L=0$ 要结合定义域或夹逼证明。

method.title: 检查定义域
method.body: 确认分母在趋近点不为 $0$，根式在所考虑的邻域内有定义。

method.title: 按法则逐层代入
method.body: 先算幂与多项式，再算积、商、根或外层幂。

method.title: 计算并解释
method.body: 写出精确结果；应用题还要检查单位及允许的趋近方向。

pitfalls: $0/0$ 是需要变形的信号，不是答案。
直接代入性质不适用于原分母为零的点。

en.title: Direct substitution and root conditions
en.summary: Use direct substitution for a polynomial at every real number and for a rational function wherever its original denominator is nonzero. The Root Law gives $\lim\sqrt[n]{f(x)}=\sqrt[n]{L}$ for a positive integer $n$. The law stated in this section assumes $L>0$ for even $n$; at the boundary $L=0$, check the domain or use a squeeze argument.

method.title: Check the domain
method.body: Confirm that the denominator is nonzero at the approach point and radicals are defined on the relevant neighborhood.

method.title: Apply the laws in order
method.body: Evaluate powers and polynomials first, then the product, quotient, root, or outer power.

method.title: Calculate and interpret
method.body: Give the exact result. For applications, also check units and the allowed direction of approach.

pitfalls: $0/0$ signals a need for simplification; it is not an answer.
Direct substitution is unavailable where the original denominator is zero.

concepts.title: 因式分解、约分与去心邻域
concepts.summary: 极限只研究 $x$ 接近 $a$ 且 $x\ne a$ 时的行为。若两个函数在这样的邻域中相等，它们在 $a$ 的极限相同。遇到 $0/0$，可先分解并约去共同因子，再求简化后函数的极限。

method.title: 试代入，辨认未定式
method.body: 若分子、分母同时趋于 $0$，寻找平方差、立方和差或一般多项式因式。

method.title: 注明条件后约分
method.body: 只在被约因子非零时写出等式；保留原函数的排除点。

method.title: 求简式极限
method.body: 检查简式的分母，再代入。单个点处无定义或被重新赋值不会改变极限。

pitfalls: 约分不会使原函数在被排除点自动有定义。
分子趋非零、分母趋零时，应检查符号与两侧行为，而非硬套约分。

en.title: Factoring, cancellation, and punctured neighborhoods
en.summary: A limit concerns $x$ near $a$ with $x\ne a$. Functions equal on such a punctured neighborhood have the same limit at $a$. For a $0/0$ form, factor and cancel a common factor before evaluating the simpler limit.

method.title: Identify the indeterminate form
method.body: If both numerator and denominator tend to $0$, look for a difference of squares, a sum or difference of cubes, or polynomial factors.

method.title: Cancel with the restriction stated
method.body: Write the equality only where the canceled factor is nonzero. Retain the excluded points of the original function.

method.title: Evaluate the simpler limit
method.body: Check the remaining denominator and substitute. An undefined or reassigned value at a single point does not change the limit.

pitfalls: Cancellation does not define the original function at an excluded point.
If the numerator tends to a nonzero number while the denominator tends to zero, examine signs and one-sided behavior.

concepts.title: 增量形式与差商
concepts.summary: 本节先用代数处理 $\lim_{h\to0}[F(x+h)-F(x)]/h$，不需要预先使用导数。展开、通分或有理化后，分子通常含 $h$，在 $h\ne0$ 时可约去。

method.title: 保留原差商
method.body: 注意 $(x+h)^n$ 与 $x^n+h^n$ 不同，参数 $x$ 在 $h\to0$ 时固定。

method.title: 展开或通分
method.body: 先消去相同常数项，把剩余分子写成 $h$ 乘一个表达式。

method.title: 约去增量，再代入
method.body: 对 $h\ne0$ 约分，检查固定参数的定义域，然后令 $h\to0$。

pitfalls: 不能先令 $h=0$ 后把 $0/0$ 当作值。
参数出现在分母时，必须保留其非零条件。

en.title: Increment forms and difference quotients
en.summary: This section treats $\lim_{h\to0}[F(x+h)-F(x)]/h$ algebraically, without using derivatives. Expansion, a common denominator, or rationalization often reveals a factor of $h$, which can be canceled when $h\ne0$.

method.title: Keep the original quotient
method.body: $(x+h)^n$ differs from $x^n+h^n$. A parameter $x$ remains fixed while $h\to0$.

method.title: Expand or combine fractions
method.body: Cancel the matching constant terms and express the remaining numerator as $h$ times another expression.

method.title: Cancel the increment and substitute
method.body: Cancel for $h\ne0$, check the domain restrictions on fixed parameters, and then let $h\to0$.

pitfalls: Do not set $h=0$ and treat $0/0$ as a value.
Retain nonzero restrictions on parameters appearing in denominators.

concepts.title: 根式差与共轭有理化
concepts.summary: 利用 $(A-B)(A+B)=A^2-B^2$，把根式差变为多项式差。只有乘上同一个非零因子的分子与分母，才能保持原式。

method.title: 找出导致 $0/0$ 的根式差
method.body: 确定根号覆盖范围和原式定义域，选择对应的共轭。

method.title: 乘共轭并化简
method.body: 写出平方差，约去共同因子；若分子分母都有根式差，可能要先后处理两次。

method.title: 检查简式并求极限
method.body: 确认简化后的分母极限非零，再代入，保留精确根式。

pitfalls: 不要把 $\sqrt{x+y}$ 拆成 $\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{y}$。
共轭乘法中的平方差必须覆盖整个根式。

en.title: Radical differences and conjugates
en.summary: Use $(A-B)(A+B)=A^2-B^2$ to turn a difference of radicals into a polynomial difference. Multiply numerator and denominator by the same nonzero conjugate.

method.title: Locate the radical difference
method.body: Check the full radicand and the original domain, then choose the corresponding conjugate.

method.title: Multiply by the conjugate and simplify
method.body: Use the difference of squares and cancel common factors. Two radical differences may require rationalizing both in turn.

method.title: Check and evaluate
method.body: Confirm a nonzero limiting denominator, substitute, and retain exact radical values.

pitfalls: Do not split $\sqrt{x+y}$ into $\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{y}$.
The difference of squares must use the entire radicand.

concepts.title: 单侧极限、绝对值与分段函数
concepts.summary: $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=L$ 当且仅当左右极限都等于 $L$。分别使用各侧适用的分支；$|u|=u$ 当 $u\ge0$，$|u|=-u$ 当 $u<0$。

method.title: 定位分界点与符号
method.body: 列出绝对值内部或分段条件在趋近点两侧的符号。

method.title: 左右分别计算
method.body: 在每一侧改写原式，独立算出左极限和右极限。

method.title: 比较并检查点值
method.body: 左右相同则双侧极限存在；不同则不存在。需要求函数值时另按该点定义计算。

pitfalls: 函数值、左极限、右极限是三个不同量。
单侧根式极限必须从定义域允许的一侧趋近。

en.title: One-sided limits, absolute values, and piecewise functions
en.summary: $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=L$ if and only if both one-sided limits equal $L$. Use the branch valid on each side; $|u|=u$ for $u\ge0$ and $|u|=-u$ for $u<0$.

method.title: Locate the boundary and signs
method.body: Determine the signs inside absolute values or the applicable piecewise branch on each side.

method.title: Compute each side separately
method.body: Rewrite the original expression using the valid branch and calculate the left- and right-hand limits independently.

method.title: Compare and check point values
method.body: Equal one-sided values give a two-sided limit; unequal values do not. Calculate the function value separately when requested.

pitfalls: The function value and the two one-sided limits are distinct quantities.
Approach a radical boundary from a side allowed by its domain.

concepts.title: 取整函数与跳跃
concepts.summary: $[x]=\lfloor x\rfloor$ 是不大于 $x$ 的最大整数。非整数 $a$ 附近取整值保持不变；在整数 $n$ 处左极限为 $n-1$、右极限为 $n$，因此双侧极限不存在。

method.title: 确定落在哪个整数区间
method.body: 先算输入在趋近点左侧与右侧分别落在哪个 $[n,n+1)$ 内。

method.title: 分别取整
method.body: 负数向下取整，例如 $[-1/2]=-1$。复合函数要先分析内层值是否跨过整数。

method.title: 比较两侧与函数值
method.body: 先比较两侧常数决定极限，再单独计算点值。图像左端实心、右端空心。

pitfalls: 取整不是向零截断。
取整函数的组合在整数点也可能消除跳跃，应看整个表达式。

en.title: The greatest integer function and jumps
en.summary: $[x]=\lfloor x\rfloor$ is the greatest integer less than or equal to $x$. Near a noninteger $a$, the floor value is constant. At an integer $n$, its left-hand limit is $n-1$ and its right-hand limit is $n$, so the two-sided limit does not exist.

method.title: Identify the integer interval
method.body: Find the intervals $[n,n+1)$ containing the input on each side of the approach point.

method.title: Take the floor on each side
method.body: Round down for negative inputs, for example $[-1/2]=-1$. For a composition, check whether the inner value crosses an integer.

method.title: Compare sides and the function value
method.body: Compare the side constants to determine the limit; then calculate the point value separately. Each floor step has a closed left endpoint and an open right endpoint.

pitfalls: The floor function is not truncation toward zero.
A combination of floor functions may cancel jumps; examine the entire expression.

concepts.title: 夹逼定理、振荡与大小比较
concepts.summary: 若 $F(x)\le G(x)\le H(x)$ 在 $a$ 的去心邻域成立，且两端都趋于同一个 $L$，则中间也趋于 $L$。特别地，$|G(x)|\le B(x)$ 且 $B(x)\to0$ 时有 $G(x)\to0$。

method.title: 建立真实上、下界
method.body: 常用 $-1\le\sin u,\cos u\le1$；乘非负振幅保持不等号，乘负数要反向。

method.title: 求两端极限
method.body: 确认上下界趋于同一个数；必要时先限定在趋近点附近以保证根式有定义。

method.title: 应用夹逼并解释
method.body: 中间函数可以振荡，但幅度被压至零。图与数值表只辅助观察，证明依靠不等式。

pitfalls: 不能把不存在的 $\lim\sin(1/x)$ 与 $0$ 相乘。
两端极限不同，不能由夹逼定理给出中间的唯一极限。

en.title: Squeeze Theorem, oscillation, and comparison
en.summary: If $F(x)\le G(x)\le H(x)$ on a punctured neighborhood of $a$ and both bounding functions tend to the same $L$, then $G(x)\to L$. In particular, $|G(x)|\le B(x)$ with $B(x)\to0$ implies $G(x)\to0$.

method.title: Establish valid bounds
method.body: Use $-1\le\sin u,\cos u\le1$. Multiplying by a nonnegative amplitude preserves the inequality; multiplying by a negative number reverses it.

method.title: Evaluate the bounding limits
method.body: Confirm that both bounds approach the same number. Restrict to a neighborhood when needed to ensure radicals are defined.

method.title: Apply the theorem and interpret
method.body: The middle function may oscillate while its amplitude shrinks to zero. Graphs and tables aid intuition; the inequality supplies the proof.

pitfalls: Do not multiply the nonexistent $\lim\sin(1/x)$ by $0$.
Bounds with different limits do not force a unique limit.

questions.label: 教材例题 1
questions.prompt: 利用图 1 中 $f$、$g$ 的图像和极限定律，求下列极限（若存在）：(a) $\lim_{x\to-2}[f(x)+5g(x)]$；(b) $\lim_{x\to1}[f(x)g(x)]$；(c) $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)/g(x)$。

steps.title: (a) 读图并应用和与常数倍法则
steps.body: 在 $x=-2$ 处曲线趋于 $\lim f(x)=1$、$\lim g(x)=-1$。因此 $\lim[f(x)+5g(x)]=1+5(-1)=-4$。$f(-2)$ 的实心点不改变这里的极限。

steps.title: (b) 分别求左右乘积极限
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to1}f(x)=2$，但 $g$ 的左极限为 $-2$、右极限为 $-1$。左右乘积分别为 $2(-2)=-4$、$2(-1)=-2$，不相等，故双侧乘积极限不存在。

steps.title: (c) 检查分母与符号
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)\approx1.4>0$、$\lim_{x\to2}g(x)=0$。图中 $g$ 在 2 左侧为负、右侧为正，所以商分别趋于 $-\infty$、$+\infty$；商法则不适用，也无双侧极限。

questions.answer: (a) $-4$；(b) 不存在；(c) 不存在（左侧 $-\infty$，右侧 $+\infty$）。

en.label: Textbook Example 1
en.prompt: Use the Limit Laws and the graphs of $f$ and $g$ in Figure 1 to evaluate the following limits, if they exist: (a) $\lim_{x\to-2}[f(x)+5g(x)]$; (b) $\lim_{x\to1}[f(x)g(x)]$; (c) $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)/g(x)$.

steps.title: (a) Read and combine the limits
steps.body: At $x=-2$, the curves give $\lim f(x)=1$ and $\lim g(x)=-1$. The Sum and Constant Multiple Laws give $1+5(-1)=-4$. The filled point defining $f(-2)$ does not change this limit.

steps.title: (b) Calculate the one-sided product limits
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to1}f(x)=2$, but the left and right limits of $g$ are $-2$ and $-1$. The product limits are $2(-2)=-4$ and $2(-1)=-2$, respectively. Their disagreement proves that the two-sided product limit does not exist.

steps.title: (c) Check the denominator and its sign
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)\approx1.4>0$ and $\lim_{x\to2}g(x)=0$. The graph shows $g<0$ to the left of 2 and $g>0$ to the right. The quotient therefore tends to $-\infty$ and $+\infty$ on the two sides; the Quotient Law is unavailable and the two-sided limit does not exist.

en.answer: (a) $-4$; (b) does not exist; (c) does not exist (left $-\infty$, right $+\infty$).

steps.title: (a) 分拆多项式极限
steps.body: 和、差、常数倍法则给出 $2\lim x^2-3\lim x+\lim4$。幂法则与基本极限给出 $2(5^2)-3(5)+4=50-15+4=39$。

steps.title: (b) 应用商法则
steps.body: 因分母极限非零，原极限等于 $(-1)/11=-1/11$。

en.label: Textbook Example 2
en.prompt: Evaluate the following limits and justify each step: (a) $\lim_{x\to5}(2x^2-3x+4)$; (b) $\lim_{x\to-2}(x^3+2x^2-1)/(5-3x)$.

steps.title: (a) Separate the polynomial terms
steps.body: The Sum, Difference, and Constant Multiple Laws give $2\lim x^2-3\lim x+\lim4$. The Power Law and basic limits yield $2(5^2)-3(5)+4=50-15+4=39$.

steps.title: (b) Evaluate numerator and denominator
steps.body: The numerator tends to $(-2)^3+2(-2)^2-1=-8+8-1=-1$. The denominator tends to $5-3(-2)=11\ne0$.

steps.title: (b) Apply the Quotient Law
steps.body: The nonzero denominator limit permits division, giving $(-1)/11=-1/11$.

steps.title: 识别 $0/0$
steps.body: 代入 $x=1$ 得分子、分母都为 $0$，所以不能使用商法则直接代入。

steps.title: 求简式极限
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to1}(x+1)=1+1=2$。原函数在 $1$ 无定义，仍可有极限 $2$。

steps.title: Recognize $0/0$
steps.body: Substitution gives zero in both numerator and denominator, so direct use of the Quotient Law is invalid.

steps.title: Evaluate the simpler limit

steps.title: 识别根式差
steps.body: 原式为 $0/0$ 型，选择分子的共轭 $\sqrt{t^2+9}+3$。

steps.title: Identify the radical difference
steps.body: The expression has form $0/0$. Use the numerator conjugate $\sqrt{t^2+9}+3$.

steps.title: Multiply and use the difference of squares
steps.body: The quotient becomes $((t^2+9)-9)/(t^2(\sqrt{t^2+9}+3))=t^2/(t^2(\sqrt{t^2+9}+3))$.

steps.title: Cancel and substitute
steps.body: Cancel $t^2$ for $t\ne0$, obtaining $1/(\sqrt{t^2+9}+3)$. The denominator tends to $3+3=6\ne0$, so the limit is $1/6$.

steps.title: Calculate the right-hand limit

steps.title: Calculate the left-hand limit
steps.body: For $x<0$, $|x|/x=(-x)/x=-1$, so the left-hand limit is $-1$.

steps.title: Compare the one-sided limits

en.answer: Does not exist: left limit $-1$, right limit $1$.

steps.title: 不用不存在的振荡极限
steps.body: $\sin(1/x)$ 在 $x\to0$ 时没有极限，不能直接使用乘积法则。对 $x\ne0$ 有 $-1\le\sin(1/x)\le1$。

steps.title: 建立两侧界
steps.body: 因为 $x^2\ge0$，乘以 $x^2$ 保持不等号：$-x^2\le x^2\sin(1/x)\le x^2$。

steps.title: 求边界极限并夹逼
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to0}(-x^2)=0=\lim_{x\to0}x^2$。由夹逼定理，中间函数的极限也为 $0$。

steps.title: Avoid the nonexistent oscillatory limit
steps.body: $\sin(1/x)$ has no limit as $x\to0$, so the Product Law cannot be applied directly. For $x\ne0$, $-1\le\sin(1/x)\le1$.

steps.title: Construct lower and upper bounds
steps.body: Multiplication by $x^2\ge0$ preserves the inequalities: $-x^2\le x^2\sin(1/x)\le x^2$.

steps.title: Evaluate the bounds and squeeze
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to0}(-x^2)=0=\lim_{x\to0}x^2$. The Squeeze Theorem therefore gives limit $0$ for the middle function.
